headline: Bitcoin slipped below $75,000 in early Monday trading in Asia as its fifth straight losing week came to a close, while Binance's post-hack troubles spread to account closures in France and the US moves to cut MEXC off from American banks.

market.asOf: No live price feed could be opened this run. investingLive put bitcoin near $74,500 in early Asian trading (published 22:11 UTC Sun 8 Nov); ETH and SOL are crypto.news readings from about 12:30 UTC Sun 8 Nov. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 28 (Fear) on Sunday 8 Nov, up from 25 (Extreme Fear) on Saturday, per CryptoTicker.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips under $75,000 as its fifth losing week closes
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below $75,000 to about $74,500 in early Monday trading in Asia, per investingLive, which saw no crypto-specific trigger, just wary risk sentiment. The weekly candle closed at 00:00 UTC Monday (07:00 Bangkok). The week opened at $78,232 per CryptoTicker or $78,354 per crypto.news, so bitcoin was on course for a fifth straight losing week. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.28 billion over 2-6 November.
points: investingLive names the 200-day moving average, a little above $73,000, as the next level traders watch; bitcoin is well below its 50-day average near $82,000.
CryptoTicker says the losing streak adds up to a loss of 12.4% from the 4 Oct weekly close of $86,507.
The $1.28B ETF outflow week was the worst since June and turned 2026 year-to-date ETF flows negative, at about -$914M, per The Block using SoSoValue data.
Altcoins fell harder over the week: ENA -18.6%, NEAR -15.2%, HYPE about -12%, while ETH fell only 1.35%, per crypto.news.
The next big scheduled test is US October inflation (CPI) on Tue 10 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok).

stories.title: Binance's hack fallout widens: French accounts to close, CFO out, USDT freeze warning
stories.summary: Binance emailed French users that all their accounts will close on 31 December, per Cointelegraph. Co-CEO Yi He also warned that USDT linked to Myanmar or Cambodia deals, or to informal off-exchange trades, could be frozen. CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving nine days after the 29 Oct hack; Yi He says the change was planned six months ago. HYPE and APT withdrawals have reopened.
points: Cointelegraph confirms France and cites media reports of similar emails to users in Spain and Belgium, which Binance did not address.
The 29 Oct hack was about $6.3B, per crypto.news.
Justin Yek, formerly of Airwallex, replaces Ng, per The Block.
INJ, Plasma, NEAR and LTC withdrawals are targeted to reopen by the end of this week, per crypto.news.

stories.title: OKX warns users about MEXC transfers after the US Treasury moves to cut MEXC off
stories.summary: The US Treasury's FinCEN ordered US financial institutions to stop moving money to or from MEXC Global, starting 30 days after the order is published in the Federal Register. Treasury paired it with sanctions on eight Canadian money businesses accused of moving Iranian funds, per crypto.news. OKX's CEO warned users not to send funds straight from MEXC to OKX.
points: FinCEN alleges at least $16B of illicit transactions over May 2021-May 2026, per crypto.news.
About $1B went directly to or from more than 40 Iranian exchanges, per crypto.news; nearly $1.5B is tied to Russian sanctions evasion, per Treasury.
MEXC holds about $4.48B in assets, per DefiLlama data cited by Cointelegraph; MEXC did not respond to Cointelegraph's request for comment.

briefs.title: Polymarket 'insider' election bets questioned
briefs.summary: The Block's on-chain analysis links an account behind about $258K of Senate-bet profits to a long-time big bettor, weakening the insider-trading theory in a New York Times story.

briefs.title: Web3Auth moves exposed Keplr funds to recovery addresses
briefs.summary: After the social-login wallet drain, Web3Auth says 12 recovery addresses now hold about $5.6M moved ahead of the hackers, per The Block. Seed-phrase and hardware wallets were not affected.

briefs.title: Vitalik: value ETH as a store of value, not a fee-burner
briefs.summary: Buterin says the case for ETH's fee burn was weaker than it appeared; only about 19,200 ETH has been burned in 2026, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance plans to rebuild its user-protection fund
briefs.summary: With HYPE and APT withdrawals back, Binance plans to rebuild its SAFU fund to about $1B; a full restoration timeline is not yet published, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: US sanctions 8 Canadian money exchangers
briefs.summary: Treasury says they swapped Iranian rials for digital assets, per Cointelegraph's daily roundup.

briefs.title: Treasury walks back the crypto travel-rule proposal
briefs.summary: FinCEN and the Fed rescinded the 2020 travel-rule proposal that would have cut the threshold for collecting transaction information to $250, per The Block.

briefs.title: Altcoins hit harder than bitcoin last week
briefs.summary: XRP fell 7.2% to $1.17 and SOL 6% to $89.63 over the week, while ETH slipped only 1.35% to $2,239, per crypto.news.

briefs.summary: CryptoTicker lists CPI on Tue 10 Nov, MSCI's review on Wed 11 Nov with Strategy and Metaplanet as removal candidates, and Trump Media noteholders able to demand up to $1B on 30 Nov.
